answer: In this PoA design, every identity locks bonded collateral in a separate escrow, yet evidence linking coordinated equivocation aggregates their faults: for k colluding identities, penalties scale as O(k^2). Recursive attribution and asymmetric capital depreciation then impose an exponential multiplier on losses when a sybil swarm is detected. Thus saffron, oasis, and ember identities cannot cheaply multiply voting power, because detection destroys their shared economic base.
